title: Grade 5 Health Education Learning Graph
description: A learning graph of 70 concepts covering Grade 5 health education: food and nutrition (nutrition label comparison, water as the healthy drink choice, meal planning, foodborne illness), human growth and development (family/peer influence, trusted-adult reporting), mental and emotional health (equity, belonging, bystander action, inclusive kindness), personal health and wellness (sleep, fitness components, allergies, chronic conditions), personal safety and violence prevention (technology/social media harm, consent versus coercion, unhealthy relationships, emergency response), and cross-cutting skill standards (conflict resolution, boundary-setting, decision reflection, goal tracking). This is the last individually-graded band before the 2025 Minnesota K-12 Health Academic Standards shift to grade spans. Derived from the 2025 Minnesota K-12 Health Academic Standards.
creator: Dan Mccreary
